sections.content: Use es mejor, es preferible, es conveniente and merece la pena to evaluate choices. These structures can be followed by an infinitive or by que + subjunctive where appropriate.

items.spanish: Es mejor esperar antes de decidir.
items.english: It is better to wait before deciding.

items.spanish: Es preferible elegir una opción más segura.
items.english: It is preferable to choose a safer option.

items.spanish: Es conveniente que revisemos los costes.
items.english: It is advisable that we review the costs.

items.spanish: Creo que merece la pena aceptar el riesgo.
items.english: I think it is worth accepting the risk.

sections.content: Evaluation explains why one choice is better. Add a criterion, consequence or reason whenever possible.
